description: Add `EnableImageGeneration` (bool, default false) to the Swarm Manager Settings struct, settings HTTP handler patch surface, and the settings page in the UI. The swarm-manager image generate CLI helper reads this setting and short-circuits when false — this is the single load-bearing enforcement point for the toggle. When false, skills see a fast, non-erroring no-op and produce text-only options. Automated tests: default state, patch to true and back, and verify CLI helper respects the current value.
name: image-generation-toggle-setting
title: Add EnableImageGeneration toggle to Swarm Manager settings
